messages:
arjun: Quick async standup — SLO/alerts/oncall follow-ups for last night. TL;DR: SLO breach during 02:00-02:30 (high token latency), root cause pinned to a rolling kernel fallback on gpu-pool-2. What I did: traced spikes, captured perf logs, forced fallback rollback, and opened infra ticket. Blockers: need runbook tweak for automated fallback rollback (current throttle is too conservative). Today: submit small runbook change + PR to reduce throttle window, coordinate with oncall for overnight canary.

lin: Thanks — can you paste the runbook link? I want to skim before approving the change.

arjun: runbook is here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/slo/fallback-rollback v2.2
Code snippet to reproduce the operator action:
```
# force fallback rollback
curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/pools/gpu-pool-2/actions -d '{"action":"rollback_kernel","target":"stable"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

kai: I can pick up the runbook edit. Small Q: do we want to lower the throttle from 5m to 90s? That seems aggressive if the fallback oscillates.

arjun: thinking 90s for first attempt, backed by a circuit-breaker: if we see >3 rollbacks in 10m revert to manual. Will add that language.

ops-bot: [alert-summary] 2450012346 - INSERTION_LATENCY_P95 > 600ms on model-serving/gpu-pool-2 (02:03 - 02:27). Incidents: 1 (auto-mitigation triggered). Links: https://observability.internal/alerts/2450012346

emily: fyi — paging threshold for that alert is currently 650ms. If mitigation reduces to 600 we should avoid paging during canaries. Suggest we keep paging at 650 but add a granular severity label so oncall sees high-priority vs warning.

arjun: good call. I'll leave paging at 650 and add severity labels: warning(600-700), page(>700). Will update the alert rule and add to the PR.

emily: SGTM, will review PR once you post it.

nate: running a quick canary now with the rollback window set to 90s on staging. Early numbers: token latency p95 went from 720ms -> 580ms after rollback; cost delta negligible. Posting the perf query:```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```

arjun: awesome, thanks @nate. That addresses the blocker. I'll open PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runbooks/pulls/314 (title: reduce-fallback-throttle + circuit-breaker).

emily: glanced — add a note in the runbook about manual escalation steps (who to pager if circuit-breaker trips).

arjun: will do. Marking blocker -> resolved for oncall handoff. Leaving a follow-up: 1) merge PR after 1 review, 2) schedule a late-night canary (Kai/Nate volunteer), 3) monitor alerts for 24h.

kai: I can take the late-night canary. I'll coordinate with ops on rotation.

lin: thx — closing loop on my side. No other blockers.

arjun: thanks all. If anything spikes ping me directly, otherwise I'll merge after emily's review. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] 2450015899 - runbooks PR 314 deployed to staging by arjun (CI green).
